class.name: IfcTextureVertex
class.brief_description: An IfcTextureVertex is a list of 2 (S, T) texture coordinates. The following additional definitions from ISO 19775 apply: Each vertex-based geometry node uses a set of 2D texture coordinates that map textures to vertices. Texture map values ( ImageTexture, PixelTexture) range from [0.0, 1.0] along the S-axis and T-axis. However, texture coordinate values may be in the range (-∞,∞). Texture coordin

members.member: The first coordinate[1] is the S, the second coordinate[2] is the T parameter value.
